title: X-Ray Fundamentals
definition: X-rays pass through the body to film or digital detectors, showing bones bright and air dark. A chest film takes seconds and answers countless questions. It remains the most common imaging study in medicine.
patient_flow: Orders arrive electronically with a clinical question; schedulers prioritize STAT, urgent, and routine. Technologists position patients, run protocols, and check image quality. Radiologists interpret on PACS workstations, dictate reports, and call critical findings directly to the ordering doctor within minutes.
code_demo:
def contrast_dose(weight_kg, ml_per_kg=1.5, max_ml=150):
    """Weight-based IV contrast dose with safety cap and kidney check flag."""
    dose = min(weight_kg * ml_per_kg, max_ml)
    return f"Contrast: {round(dose)} mL (check creatinine/eGFR before administering)"
print(contrast_dose(80))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
